statement.en: This level is set in Halifax, the capital of Nova Scotia. Discover Canada calls it the largest east coast port in the country, deep-water and ice-free. The city has long mattered to Atlantic trade and defence, and Canada's largest naval base is here.
statement.fr: Ce niveau se déroule à Halifax, la capitale de la Nouvelle-Écosse. Découvrir le Canada en fait le plus grand port de la côte est du pays, en eau profonde et libre de glace. La ville compte depuis longtemps pour le commerce et la défense de l'Atlantique, et la plus grande base navale du Canada s'y trouve.

source.quote: As Canada’s largest east coast port, deep-water and ice-free, the capital, Halifax, has played an important role in Atlantic trade and defence and is home to Canada’s largest naval base.

verification.evidence: Nova Scotia is the most populous Atlantic Province, with a rich history as the gateway to Canada. … As Canada’s largest east coast port, deep-water and ice-free, the capital, Halifax, has played an important role in Atlantic trade and defence and is home to Canada’s largest naval base.

blurb.en: Stand by the clock a moment. Canadians inherited a tradition of ordered liberty that is 800 years old. It goes back to the signing of Magna Carta in England in 1215, also called the Great Charter of Freedoms.
blurb.fr: Arrêtez-vous un instant près de l'horloge. Les Canadiens ont hérité d'une tradition de liberté ordonnée vieille de 800 ans. Elle remonte à la signature de la Magna Carta en Angleterre en 1215, aussi appelée la Grande Charte des libertés.

source.quote: Together, these secure for Canadians an 800-year old tradition of ordered liberty, which dates back to the signing of Magna Carta in 1215 in England (also known as the Great Charter of Freedoms)

verification.evidence: Together, these secure for Canadians an 800-year old tradition of ordered liberty, which dates back to the signing of Magna Carta in 1215 in England (also known as the Great Charter of Freedoms)

blurb.en: Taking responsibility for yourself and your family is a responsibility of citizenship. Getting a job, caring for your family and working hard are important Canadian values.
blurb.fr: Prendre soin de soi et de sa famille est une responsabilité de la citoyenneté. Trouver un emploi, prendre soin de sa famille et travailler fort sont des valeurs canadiennes importantes.

source.quote: Taking responsibility for oneself and one's family — Getting a job, taking care of one's family and working hard in keeping with one's abilities are important Canadian values.

verification.evidence: Citizenship Responsibilities In Canada, rights come with responsibilities. These include: … Taking responsibility for oneself and one’s family — Getting a job, taking care of one’s family and working hard in keeping with one’s abilities are important Canadian values.

blurb.en: This is Pier 21. Canadian citizens have both rights and responsibilities. They come from the country's history, they are protected by Canadian law, and they reflect traditions, an identity and values that Canadians share.
blurb.fr: Voici le Quai 21. Les citoyens canadiens ont des droits et des responsabilités. Ils viennent de l'histoire du pays, ils sont protégés par le droit canadien et ils reflètent des traditions, une identité et des valeurs que les Canadiens ont en commun.

source.quote: Canadian citizens have rights and responsibilities. These come to us from our history, are secured by Canadian law, and reflect our shared traditions, identity, and values.

verification.evidence: Canadian citizens have rights and responsibilities. These come to us from our history, are secured by Canadian law, and reflect our shared traditions, identity, and values.

blurb.en: Look at the work going on in this harbour. When you help to protect your community, you walk the same path as the Canadians before you who gave something up in the service of this country.
blurb.fr: Regardez le travail qui se fait dans ce port. Quand vous aidez à protéger votre collectivité, vous suivez le même chemin que les Canadiens avant vous, qui ont donné beaucoup au service de ce pays.

source.quote: By helping to protect your community, you follow in the footsteps of Canadians before you who made sacrifices in the service of our country.

verification.evidence: By helping to protect your community, you follow in the footsteps of Canadians before you who made sacrifices in the service of our country.
